summary: Nexus operations with NoValue inputs bypass payload codec encoding in workflows, causing asymmetric serialization/deserialization that fails when payloads are decoded through the codec.
userImpact: Users cannot use Nexus operations with no arguments when a payload codec is configured, causing workflow execution failures.
rootCause: Asymmetric handling of null payloads: null inputs are not passed through the codec during encoding in WorkflowCodecHelper, but are always passed through during decoding in NexusPayloadSerializer.
keyQuote: When `Input` is `null`, the payload (or lack thereof) does not go through a payload codec.
